text: The stove's dead and the little one's coughing. There's coal spilled by the platform in the yard. One sack. Bring it and I lift the bar on the side door.
Side door's open. In through the cellar and out the other side, if they're on your heels.
Sirens again. Stay low, girls. Stay low.
They walk past the window now. They don't stop. Not yet.
Down here, quick. My wife and the girls are behind the blanket. They don't need to see you.
Twelve years I riveted wings in Hall One. Never once asked where they were going.
Coal. Thank you. Here, the side door, I'll take the bar off. Use it.
Get up! Somebody get him up!
